rubric.criterion: Identifies the CREATE_NEW handling bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java getOrCreateRegularFile where existing files are opened even when CREATE_NEW is specified
Identifies the regular-file lookup bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java lookUpRegularFile where non-regular files return null instead of throwing FileSystemException
Identifies the CREATE_NEW enforcement bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java getOrCreateRegularFileWithWriteLock where createFile is called with failIfExists=false
Identifies the directory stream link-handling bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java newDirectoryStream where NOFOLLOW_LINKS is always used
Identifies the cross-filesystem hard-link bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java link where the same-file-system check is removed
Identifies the hard-link equality bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java isSameFile where DirectoryEntry equality is used instead of file identity
Identifies the toRealPath ordering bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java toRealPath where names are not reversed before creating the path
Identifies the delete locking bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java deleteFile where a read lock is used instead of a write lock
Identifies the move-into-subdir bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java copy where checkNotAncestor is skipped for same-FS moves
Identifies the REPLACE_EXISTING bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java copy where the source entry is deleted instead of the destination
Identifies the readAttributes link-option bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java readAttributes(String,...) where FOLLOW_LINKS is always used
Identifies the setAttribute link-option bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java setAttribute where FOLLOW_LINKS is always used
Identifies the checkAccess link-option bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java checkAccess where NOFOLLOW_LINKS is always used
Identifies the createDirectory idempotency bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java createDirectory where existing directories are allowed
Identifies the readSymbolicLink resolution bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java readSymbolicLink where the target is resolved to a real path
Identifies the missing-root fallback bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileTree.java lookUp where unknown roots fall back to working directory
Identifies the empty-path handling bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileTree.java lookUp where EMPTY_PATH_NAMES substitution is removed
Identifies the intermediate symlink bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileTree.java lookUp where NOFOLLOW_LINKS causes a null traversal for symlinks in the middle of the path
Identifies the symlink-resolution bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileTree.java followSymbolicLink where NOFOLLOW_LINKS is used for the target lookup
Identifies the real-entry bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileTree.java getRealEntry where '.' and '..' entries are not resolved to their parent entry
Identifies the empty-path predicate bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileTree.java isEmpty where a single empty-name path is not treated as empty
Identifies the link-count decrement bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/Directory.java remove where decrementLinkCount is omitted
Identifies the directory resize-threshold bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/Directory.java expandIfNeeded where the resize is skipped at threshold
Identifies the bucket index bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/Directory.java bucketIndex where modulo can yield negative indices
Identifies the iterator bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/Directory.java iterator where pre-increment skips entries in the first bucket
Identifies the reserved-name link bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/Directory.java link where checkNotReserved is skipped
Identifies the forcePut bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/Directory.java forcePut where overwrite is disabled
Identifies the isEmpty boundary bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/Directory.java isEmpty where entryCount < 2 is treated as empty
Identifies the truncate boundary bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java truncate where lastPosition is set to size, not size-1
Identifies the truncate over-free bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java truncate where disk.free is called with blocksToRemove + 1
Identifies the write allocation off-by-one in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java prepareForWrite where additionalBlocksNeeded subtracts 1
Identifies the sparse-write size bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java prepareForWrite where size is set to end rather than pos
Identifies the write size update bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java write(byte[],...) where size is set to endPos-1
Identifies the ByteBuffer length bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java write(ByteBuffer) where capacity is used instead of remaining
Identifies the signed-byte read bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java read(long) where the byte value is returned without unsigned conversion
Identifies the read length bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java read(byte[],...) where length(remaining) ignores offsetInBlock
Identifies the scatter-read EOF bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java read(Iterable<ByteBuffer>) where EOF returns 0 instead of -1
Identifies the transferFrom EOF guard bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java transferFrom where startPos >= size prevents EOF appends
Identifies the transferFrom size update bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java transferFrom where size is not updated after writing
Identifies the transferTo block offset bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java transferTo where subsequent blocks are wrapped with the original offset
Identifies the copyBlocksTo off-by-one bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java copyBlocksTo where start is blockCount - count - 1
Identifies the transferBlocksTo truncation bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java transferBlocksTo where truncateBlocks uses blockCount - count - 1
Identifies the truncateBlocks clearing bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java truncateBlocks where clear length is blockCount - count - 1
Identifies the deleteContents size bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java deleteContents where size is not reset to 0
Identifies the open-count decrement bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java closed where openCount-- is used instead of --openCount
Identifies the hard-link delete bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java deleted where content is freed even when links remain
Identifies the EOF bytesToRead bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java bytesToRead where 0 is returned instead of -1
Identifies the block length bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java length(int,long) where offset is ignored
Identifies the blockIndex overflow bug in jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java blockIndex where the cast occurs before division
